title: RumVitalWebsocketMessageDirection
description: Schema of the messages observed in one direction of a WebSocket connection

message_count.description: Number of messages observed in this direction since the connection opened

message_size_total.description: Sum of the payload sizes of the messages observed in this direction, in bytes

message_size_max.description: Size of the largest single payload observed in this direction, in bytes. 0 while no message has been observed

longest_silence.description: Longest interval between two consecutive messages observed in this direction, in nanoseconds, including the still-open interval since the last message.

time_to_first_message.description: Interval between the open date of the connection and the first message observed in this direction, in nanoseconds. Omitted until a first message has been observed

silence_before_close.description: Interval between the last message observed in this direction and the closed date of the connection, in nanoseconds. Set on the websocket_closed vital only, and only when at least one message has been observed in this direction
